# 1. Build the DEG Pool (Backbone, restricted to the common universe)

```{r build-deg-pool}
d1 <- read_excel("DEGs_full_toptable_three_contrasts.xlsx", sheet = "eMPC_vs_iPSC") %>%
  dplyr::rename(L1_logFC = logFC, L1_t = t, L1_pval = P.Value, L1_padj_full_backbone = adj.P.Val)
d2 <- read_excel("DEGs_full_toptable_three_contrasts.xlsx", sheet = "EC_vs_eMPC") %>%
  dplyr::rename(L2_logFC = logFC, L2_t = t, L2_pval = P.Value, L2_padj_full_backbone = adj.P.Val)
d3 <- read_excel("DEGs_full_toptable_three_contrasts.xlsx", sheet = "EC_vs_iPSC") %>%
  dplyr::rename(L3_logFC = logFC, L3_t = t, L3_pval = P.Value, L3_padj_full_backbone = adj.P.Val)

wide_full <- d1 %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(d2, by = "GeneID") %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(d3, by = "GeneID")
cat("Genes in wide table (full backbone):", nrow(wide_full), "\n")
```

```{r restrict-common-universe}
# Restrict to the 11,113-gene common universe (backbone ∩ GSE271101,
# Section 3.2.8) — "backbone validated" = common universe.

common_universe_genes <- readRDS("common_universe_genes.rds") 
cat("Common universe genes:", length(common_universe_genes), "\n")

wide <- wide_full %>% dplyr::filter(GeneID %in% common_universe_genes)
cat("Genes in wide table (restricted to common universe):", nrow(wide), "\n")

# Recompute BH adjustment within the common-universe testing set — the
# original adj.P.Val columns were corrected against the full backbone
# gene set (13,611 genes here), not this restricted set.
wide <- wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    L1_padj = p.adjust(L1_pval, method = "BH"),
    L2_padj = p.adjust(L2_pval, method = "BH"),
    L3_padj = p.adjust(L3_pval, method = "BH")
  )
```

```{r deg-pool-strict}
# Primary DEG pool: padj < 0.05 & |log2FC| >= 1, now computed within
# the common-universe testing set.
is_deg_L1 <- wide$L1_padj < 0.05 & abs(wide$L1_logFC) >= 1
is_deg_L2 <- wide$L2_padj < 0.05 & abs(wide$L2_logFC) >= 1
is_deg_L3 <- wide$L3_padj < 0.05 & abs(wide$L3_logFC) >= 1
deg_pool <- wide$GeneID[is_deg_L1 | is_deg_L2 | is_deg_L3]
cat("DEGs (backbone within common universe, any contrast, padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>=1):",
    length(deg_pool), "\n")
```

```{r deg-pool-broad}
# Sensitivity analysis only — NOT used in the main pool. Drops the
# |log2FC| >= 1 threshold, same rationale as before, now within the
# common-universe testing set.
is_deg_L1_broad <- wide$L1_padj < 0.05
is_deg_L2_broad <- wide$L2_padj < 0.05
is_deg_L3_broad <- wide$L3_padj < 0.05
deg_pool_broad <- wide$GeneID[is_deg_L1_broad | is_deg_L2_broad | is_deg_L3_broad]
cat("DEGs (backbone within common universe, any contrast, padj<0.05 only):",
    length(deg_pool_broad), "\n")
cat("Difference (broad - strict):", length(deg_pool_broad) - length(deg_pool), "\n")
```

# 2. Build the Leading-Edge Gene Pool (yes_apriori Pathways)

```{r load_curation_and_leading_edge}
# Load the a priori curated GO term file and extract leading edge genes
# from yes_apriori pathways, following the same self-sufficient logic
# already used in Molecular_Signatures.Rmd and
# STRING_Network.Rmd.

curation_eMPC_vs_iPSC <- read_excel(
  "~/Desktop/Tese/R/GSEA_GO_BP_curated_apriori.xlsx", sheet = "eMPC_vs_iPSC", skip = 2)
curation_EC_vs_eMPC   <- read_excel(
  "~/Desktop/Tese/R/GSEA_GO_BP_curated_apriori.xlsx", sheet = "EC_vs_eMPC", skip = 0)
curation_EC_vs_iPSC   <- read_excel(
  "~/Desktop/Tese/R/GSEA_GO_BP_curated_apriori.xlsx", sheet = "EC_vs_iPSC", skip = 0)

extract_leadinggene <- function(curation_df, contrast_name) {

  n <- ncol(curation_df)
  colnames(curation_df)[2] <- "include_apriori_std"
  colnames(curation_df)[3] <- "contrast_side_std"
  colnames(curation_df)[4] <- "biological_category_std"
  colnames(curation_df)[n] <- "leadingEdge_std"

  stopifnot(colnames(curation_df)[2] == "include_apriori_std")

  selected <- curation_df[
    !is.na(curation_df$include_apriori_std) &
    curation_df$include_apriori_std == "yes_apriori", ]

  cat(contrast_name, "— yes_apriori pathways:", nrow(selected), "\n")

  result <- selected %>%
    dplyr::select(
      pathway              = pathway,
      pathway_clean         = pathway_clean,
      contrast_side         = contrast_side_std,
      biological_category   = biological_category_std,
      NES,
      leadingEdge           = leadingEdge_std
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      contrast = contrast_name,
      leadingEdge = as.character(leadingEdge)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::separate_rows(leadingEdge, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    dplyr::rename(gene = leadingEdge) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "")

  return(result)
}

le_eMPC_vs_iPSC <- extract_leadinggene(curation_eMPC_vs_iPSC, "eMPC_vs_iPSC")
le_EC_vs_eMPC   <- extract_leadinggene(curation_EC_vs_eMPC,   "EC_vs_eMPC")
le_EC_vs_iPSC   <- extract_leadinggene(curation_EC_vs_iPSC,   "EC_vs_iPSC")

le_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(le_eMPC_vs_iPSC, le_EC_vs_eMPC, le_EC_vs_iPSC)
leading_edge_pool <- unique(le_all$gene)

cat("\nLeading edge genes (yes_apriori, union across contrasts):", length(leading_edge_pool), "\n")
```

```{r combine_pools}
# Combine the two pools: DEGs (backbone, any contrast) union leading
# edge genes (yes_apriori). This broad pool is intersected with the TF
# catalogue in Section 3 — restricting to yes_apriori genes alone would
# risk missing TFs that drive the trajectory without themselves being a
# leading-edge member of a curated pathway.

combined_pool <- union(deg_pool, leading_edge_pool)

cat("DEG pool:", length(deg_pool), "\n")
cat("Leading edge pool:", length(leading_edge_pool), "\n")
cat("Combined pool (union):", length(combined_pool), "\n")
```

# 3. Filter to Known Transcription Factors (CollecTRI)

```{r load_collectri}
# Retrieve the CollecTRI regulon network directly via the OmniPath REST
# API. The decoupleR::get_collectri() wrapper and the OmnipathR
# transcriptional()/import_transcriptional_interactions() functions were
# tried first but failed consistently due to OmniPath server-side
# instability (confirmed via repeated attempts and a "static table
# backup" warning) — this direct API call bypasses the failing wrapper
# layer. 

# CollecTRI is used here as the primary regulon resource for the initial
# TF activity analysis; its results are subsequently cross-checked
# against DoRothEA and AnimalTFDB4 in the sections below.

# Columns of interest: source_genesymbol/target_genesymbol (TF/target
# gene symbols), consensus_stimulation/consensus_inhibition (character
# "True"/"False", NOT numeric/logical — confirmed via str()). Mode of
# regulation (mor) is derived as +1/-1 from these two columns;
# interactions with ambiguous or contradictory consensus direction
# (both True, or both False) are excluded.

collectri_raw <- read.csv(
  "https://omnipathdb.org/interactions?resources=CollecTRI&types=transcriptional&genesymbols=1",
  sep = "\t"
)

collectri_net <- collectri_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(consensus_stimulation == "True" | consensus_inhibition == "True") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mor = dplyr::case_when(
      consensus_stimulation == "True" & consensus_inhibition == "False" ~ 1,
      consensus_inhibition == "True" & consensus_stimulation == "False" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(mor)) %>%
  dplyr::select(source = source_genesymbol, target = target_genesymbol, mor) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(source, target, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("CollecTRI regulon — TFs:", dplyr::n_distinct(collectri_net$source), "\n")
cat("CollecTRI regulon — TF-target edges:", nrow(collectri_net), "\n")
```

```{r filter_pool_to_tfs}
# Restrict the combined pool to genes that are themselves TFs in the
# CollecTRI catalogue (i.e. appear as a "source" in the regulon).

tf_catalogue <- unique(collectri_net$source)
candidate_tfs <- intersect(combined_pool, tf_catalogue)

cat("Combined pool genes that are known TFs (CollecTRI):", length(candidate_tfs), "\n")
```

# 4. TF Activity Scoring per Contrast (decoupleR)

```{r build_t_matrix}
# Build a genes x contrasts matrix of t-statistics (moderated t from
# the backbone eBayes fit), used as input for regulon activity scoring.
# t-statistics are used rather than logFC, consistent with the ranking
# metric already used for GSEA (Section 3.2.9) — it incorporates both
# effect size and variance.

mat_t <- wide %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneID, L1_t, L2_t, L3_t) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("GeneID") %>%
  as.matrix()

colnames(mat_t) <- c("eMPC_vs_iPSC", "EC_vs_eMPC", "EC_vs_iPSC")

cat("t-statistic matrix:", nrow(mat_t), "genes x", ncol(mat_t), "contrasts\n")
```

```{r run_decoupler}
# Run univariate linear model (ulm) TF activity inference per contrast,
# against the full CollecTRI network (not restricted to candidate_tfs
# here — decoupleR requires the full regulon to compute activity scores
# correctly; filtering to candidate_tfs happens afterwards, in Section 5).
# minsize = 5: TFs with fewer than 5 target genes present in mat_t are
# excluded, as per decoupleR's standard recommendation.

tf_activity <- decoupleR::run_ulm(
  mat     = mat_t,
  network = collectri_net,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor    = "mor",
  minsize = 5
)

cat("TF activity estimates:", nrow(tf_activity), "\n")
head(tf_activity)
```

# 5. Combine Evidence and Score TFs

```{r evidence_scoring}
# For each candidate TF, count the number of complementary evidence types:
#   1 point  — is a DEG in the backbone (any contrast)
#   1 point  — is a leading-edge gene of a yes_apriori pathway
#   1 point  — has regulon activity with nominal p_value < 0.05 in at least one 
# contrast, per decoupleR
# TFs with more evidence types are prioritised for the main timeline figure.

tf_activity_sig <- tf_activity %>%
  dplyr::filter(statistic == "ulm", p_value < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(source) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_significant_contrasts = dplyr::n_distinct(condition),
    contrasts_significant    = paste(unique(condition), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

evidence_table <- data.frame(TF = candidate_tfs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_deg = TF %in% deg_pool,
    is_leading_edge = TF %in% leading_edge_pool,
    has_regulon_activity = TF %in% tf_activity_sig$source,
    n_evidence_types = is_deg + is_leading_edge + has_regulon_activity
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tf_activity_sig, by = c("TF" = "source")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_evidence_types))

cat("=== Evidence score distribution ===\n")
print(table(evidence_table$n_evidence_types))
```
## 5B. Sensitivity Analysis: BH Correction of TF Activity

```{r tf_activity_bh_sensitivity}
# Sensitivity analysis: the regulon-activity evidence above uses nominal
# p < 0.05 in at least one contrast. Here, decoupleR p-values are adjusted
# with Benjamini-Hochberg within each contrast, to check which candidates
# retain significant activity after multiple-testing correction.
# The original selection criteria are NOT changed by this check.

top10 <- c("ZEB2", "RELA", "NFKB1", "SMAD3", "NOTCH1",
           "GATA2", "LEF1", "NR2F2", "HIPK2", "HEY1")

tf_activity_bh <- tf_activity %>%
  dplyr::filter(statistic == "ulm") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Main-pool TFs (n_evidence_types == 3)
main45 <- evidence_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_evidence_types == 3) %>%
  dplyr::pull(TF)

bh_summary <- tf_activity_bh %>%
  dplyr::filter(source %in% main45) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(source) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sig_nominal = sum(p_value < 0.05),
    n_sig_BH      = sum(padj < 0.05),
    min_padj      = min(padj),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(main_figure = source %in% top10) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(main_figure), dplyr::desc(n_sig_BH), min_padj)

# Check: main-pool TFs retaining at least one significant contrast after BH
# (expect 45 in total: 28 TRUE, 17 FALSE)
cat("Main-pool TFs:", length(main45), "\n")
print(table(retains_activity_BH = bh_summary$n_sig_BH > 0))

# The 10 main-figure TFs (expect 9 retained; GATA2 not retained, min padj = 0.052)
bh_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(main_figure) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "bh_summary_main45"   = bh_summary,
    "tf_activity_with_BH" = tf_activity_bh
  ),
  path = "TF_activity_BH_sensitivity.xlsx"
)
cat("Exported TF_activity_BH_sensitivity.xlsx\n")
```
## 5C. TF Expression vs. Inferred Regulatory Activity

```{r tf_expression_vs_activity}
# Compares, for the 45 main-pool TFs (and separately for the 10 main-figure
# TFs), the trajectory of inferred regulon activity with the expression
# trajectory of the TF-encoding gene itself.
#   - Trajectory classes use the same sign-based logic for both layers
#     (L1 = eMPC vs iPSC, L2 = EC vs eMPC): monotonic_increase (+/+),
#     monotonic_decrease (-/-), eMPC_peak (+/-), eMPC_trough (-/+).
#   - Sign agreement is also assessed per contrast (L1, L2, L3).
#   - Spearman correlation between activity scores and TF log2FC per contrast.
#   - "Strong" discordance: opposite signs AND significance on both layers in
#     the same contrast. Primary criterion (consistent with TF selection):
#     activity nominal p < 0.05; expression adjusted p < 0.05 (BH within the
#     common universe, without the |log2FC| filter).
#     Sensitivity criterion: activity BH-adjusted p < 0.05 (tf_activity_bh,
#     Section 5B); expression criterion unchanged.
# Discordance is descriptive: TF activity can depend on mechanisms not
# captured by TF transcript abundance.

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

classify_traj <- function(x1, x2) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x1 > 0 & x2 > 0 ~ "monotonic_increase",
    x1 < 0 & x2 < 0 ~ "monotonic_decrease",
    x1 > 0 & x2 < 0 ~ "eMPC_peak",
    x1 < 0 & x2 > 0 ~ "eMPC_trough",
    TRUE            ~ NA_character_
  )
}

top10 <- c("ZEB2", "RELA", "NFKB1", "SMAD3", "NOTCH1",
           "GATA2", "LEF1", "NR2F2", "HIPK2", "HEY1")

main45 <- evidence_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_evidence_types == 3) %>%
  dplyr::pull(TF)

# Activity scores and nominal p-values, one row per TF
act_wide <- tf_activity %>%
  dplyr::filter(statistic == "ulm", source %in% main45) %>%
  dplyr::select(source, condition, score, p_value) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = c(score, p_value))

# BH-adjusted activity p-values (sensitivity), one row per TF
act_padj_wide <- tf_activity_bh %>%
  dplyr::filter(source %in% main45) %>%
  dplyr::select(source, condition, padj) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = padj,
                     names_prefix = "act_padj_")

# TF-encoding gene expression (log2FC and common-universe adjusted p)
expr_tf <- wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(GeneID %in% main45) %>%
  dplyr::select(GeneID, L1_logFC, L2_logFC, L3_logFC, L1_padj, L2_padj, L3_padj)

tf_expr_act <- act_wide %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(expr_tf, by = c("source" = "GeneID")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(act_padj_wide, by = "source") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    activity_class   = classify_traj(score_eMPC_vs_iPSC, score_EC_vs_eMPC),
    expression_class = classify_traj(L1_logFC, L2_logFC),
    trajectory_concordant = activity_class == expression_class,

    sign_agree_L1 = sign(score_eMPC_vs_iPSC) == sign(L1_logFC),
    sign_agree_L2 = sign(score_EC_vs_eMPC)   == sign(L2_logFC),
    sign_agree_L3 = sign(score_EC_vs_iPSC)   == sign(L3_logFC),

    # Primary criterion: activity nominal p < 0.05
    strong_disc_L1 = !sign_agree_L1 & p_value_eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0.05 & L1_padj < 0.05,
    strong_disc_L2 = !sign_agree_L2 & p_value_EC_vs_eMPC   < 0.05 & L2_padj < 0.05,
    strong_disc_L3 = !sign_agree_L3 & p_value_EC_vs_iPSC   < 0.05 & L3_padj < 0.05,

    # Sensitivity criterion: activity BH-adjusted p < 0.05
    strong_disc_BH_L1 = !sign_agree_L1 & act_padj_eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0.05 & L1_padj < 0.05,
    strong_disc_BH_L2 = !sign_agree_L2 & act_padj_EC_vs_eMPC   < 0.05 & L2_padj < 0.05,
    strong_disc_BH_L3 = !sign_agree_L3 & act_padj_EC_vs_iPSC   < 0.05 & L3_padj < 0.05,

    n_contrasts_sign_agree   = sign_agree_L1 + sign_agree_L2 + sign_agree_L3,
    n_strong_discordances    = strong_disc_L1 + strong_disc_L2 + strong_disc_L3,
    n_strong_discordances_BH = strong_disc_BH_L1 + strong_disc_BH_L2 + strong_disc_BH_L3,
    main_figure = source %in% top10
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(main_figure), source)

# Check: 45 TFs, no missing classes (expect 45 and 0)
nrow(tf_expr_act)
sum(is.na(tf_expr_act$activity_class) | is.na(tf_expr_act$expression_class))

# Check: classes match the TF manipulability screening table (expect 0 mismatches)
screening_file <- "TF_manipulability_screening_2026-09-20.xlsx"
if (file.exists(screening_file)) {
  scr <- readxl::read_excel(screening_file) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(TF)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(TF, regulon_activity_pattern, TF_expression_pattern)
  chk <- tf_expr_act %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(scr, by = c("source" = "TF")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(activity_class != regulon_activity_pattern |
                  expression_class != TF_expression_pattern)
  cat("TFs compared with screening table:",
      dplyr::n_distinct(scr$TF[scr$TF %in% tf_expr_act$source]),
      "| mismatches:", nrow(chk), "\n")
  if (nrow(chk) > 0) print(chk[, c("source", "activity_class", "regulon_activity_pattern",
                                   "expression_class", "TF_expression_pattern")])
} else {
  cat("Screening file not found in working directory; class check skipped.\n")
}

# 1. Trajectory concordance: all 45 and the 10 main-figure TFs
cat("\nTrajectory concordance (45 main-pool TFs):\n")
print(table(concordant = tf_expr_act$trajectory_concordant))
cat("\nTrajectory concordance (10 main-figure TFs):\n")
print(table(concordant = tf_expr_act$trajectory_concordant[tf_expr_act$main_figure]))

cat("\nActivity class (rows) vs expression class (columns), 45 TFs:\n")
print(table(activity = tf_expr_act$activity_class,
            expression = tf_expr_act$expression_class))

# 2. Sign agreement per contrast (number of TFs out of 45)
cat("\nSign agreement per contrast (45 TFs):\n")
print(colSums(tf_expr_act[, c("sign_agree_L1", "sign_agree_L2", "sign_agree_L3")]))

# 3. Spearman correlation between activity score and TF log2FC, per contrast
spearman_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  list(c("score_eMPC_vs_iPSC", "L1_logFC", "eMPC_vs_iPSC"),
       c("score_EC_vs_eMPC",   "L2_logFC", "EC_vs_eMPC"),
       c("score_EC_vs_iPSC",   "L3_logFC", "EC_vs_iPSC")),
  function(v) {
    ct <- cor.test(tf_expr_act[[v[1]]], tf_expr_act[[v[2]]],
                   method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
    data.frame(contrast = v[3], rho = unname(ct$estimate), p_value = ct$p.value)
  }
))
cat("\nSpearman correlation, activity score vs TF log2FC (45 TFs):\n")
print(spearman_tbl)

# 4. Strong discordances: primary (nominal) and sensitivity (BH) criteria
disc_cols <- c("source", "main_figure", "activity_class", "expression_class",
               "strong_disc_L1", "strong_disc_L2", "strong_disc_L3",
               "strong_disc_BH_L1", "strong_disc_BH_L2", "strong_disc_BH_L3",
               "score_eMPC_vs_iPSC", "L1_logFC", "score_EC_vs_eMPC", "L2_logFC",
               "score_EC_vs_iPSC", "L3_logFC")

strong_disc <- tf_expr_act %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_strong_discordances > 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(disc_cols))

# Expect 12 TFs (primary) and 6 TFs (BH: HEY1, HIPK2, NR2F2, HHEX, HOXB3, SNAI1)
cat("\nTFs with at least one strong discordance (primary, nominal activity p):",
    nrow(strong_disc), "\n")
cat("TFs with at least one strong discordance (sensitivity, BH activity p):",
    sum(tf_expr_act$n_strong_discordances_BH > 0), "\n")
cat("Main-figure TFs with strong discordance (primary):",
    paste(strong_disc$source[strong_disc$main_figure], collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Main-figure TFs with strong discordance (BH):",
    paste(tf_expr_act$source[tf_expr_act$main_figure &
                             tf_expr_act$n_strong_discordances_BH > 0], collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
print(strong_disc, n = Inf, width = Inf)

write_xlsx(
  list(
    "tf_expression_vs_activity" = tf_expr_act,
    "spearman_by_contrast"      = spearman_tbl,
    "strong_discordances"       = strong_disc
  ),
  path = "TF_expression_vs_activity.xlsx"
)
cat("\nExported TF_expression_vs_activity.xlsx\n")
```

## 5D. Activity Heatmap of the 10 Representative TFs (Main Figure)

```{r tf_activity_heatmap_top10, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4.2}
# Heatmap of inferred regulon activity (decoupleR ulm scores, CollecTRI) for
# the 10 representative TFs across the three backbone contrasts.
# Style follows the module-score heatmap (Molecular Signatures, Section 4.6.1).
#   - Rows grouped by assigned stage (iPSC, eMPC, EC), in the same order as
#     the integrated timeline figure. Stage assignment follows the rule
#     applied in the IntegratedTimeline Rmd: eMPC_peak -> eMPC;
#     monotonic_increase -> EC; monotonic_decrease -> iPSC; eMPC_trough ->
#     EC or iPSC according to the sign of the EC vs iPSC activity score.
#   - Cell values: activity score; "*" nominal p < 0.05; "**" also
#     BH-adjusted p < 0.05 (Section 5B).
#   - Right-hand text: expression trajectory of the TF-encoding gene
#     (Section 5C), with the same class names as the appendix table.
#     The "TF expression" header is drawn with decorate_annotation(), as the
#     annotation name is not displayed when column names are on top.

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)

top10_order <- c("HEY1", "HIPK2",                     # iPSC
                 "LEF1", "NR2F2",                     # eMPC
                 "ZEB2", "SMAD3", "RELA", "NOTCH1", "NFKB1", "GATA2")  # EC
contrast_order  <- c("eMPC_vs_iPSC", "EC_vs_eMPC", "EC_vs_iPSC")
contrast_labels <- c("eMPC vs iPSC", "EC vs eMPC", "EC vs iPSC")

hm_df <- tf_expr_act %>%
  dplyr::filter(source %in% top10_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    assigned_stage = dplyr::case_when(
      activity_class == "eMPC_peak"                          ~ "eMPC",
      activity_class == "monotonic_increase"                 ~ "EC",
      activity_class == "monotonic_decrease"                 ~ "iPSC",
      activity_class == "eMPC_trough" & score_EC_vs_iPSC > 0 ~ "EC",
      activity_class == "eMPC_trough" & score_EC_vs_iPSC < 0 ~ "iPSC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = factor(source, levels = top10_order)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(source)

# Check: stage assignment matches the IntegratedTimeline Rmd (expect no error)
expected_stage <- c(HEY1 = "iPSC", HIPK2 = "iPSC", LEF1 = "eMPC", NR2F2 = "eMPC",
                    ZEB2 = "EC", SMAD3 = "EC", RELA = "EC", NOTCH1 = "EC",
                    NFKB1 = "EC", GATA2 = "EC")
stopifnot(nrow(hm_df) == 10,
          all(hm_df$assigned_stage == expected_stage[as.character(hm_df$source)]))

# Matrices: scores, nominal p, BH-adjusted p
score_mat <- as.matrix(hm_df[, paste0("score_", contrast_order)])
p_mat     <- as.matrix(hm_df[, paste0("p_value_", contrast_order)])
padj_mat  <- as.matrix(hm_df[, paste0("act_padj_", contrast_order)])
rownames(score_mat) <- as.character(hm_df$source)
colnames(score_mat) <- contrast_labels

sig_mat  <- ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05, "**", ifelse(p_mat < 0.05, "*", ""))
cell_lab <- matrix(paste0(sprintf("%.1f", score_mat), sig_mat),
                   nrow = nrow(score_mat), dimnames = dimnames(score_mat))

# Expression trajectory of the TF-encoding gene (same names as Table A.3)
expr_text <- unname(c(monotonic_increase = "monotonic increase",
                      monotonic_decrease = "monotonic decrease",
                      eMPC_peak          = "eMPC peak",
                      eMPC_trough        = "eMPC trough")[hm_df$expression_class])

right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  tf_expr = anno_text(
    expr_text,
    gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, col = "grey30"),
    location = 0, just = "left",
    width = max_text_width(expr_text, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)) + unit(2, "mm")
  ),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

max_abs <- max(abs(score_mat))
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-max_abs, 0, max_abs), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

ht_top10 <- Heatmap(
  score_mat,
  name = "Activity\nscore",
  col = col_fun,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_split = factor(hm_df$assigned_stage, levels = c("iPSC", "eMPC", "EC")),
  row_title_rot = 0,
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold", col = "grey30"),
  row_gap = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  row_names_side = "left",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_names_side = "top",
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
  width  = unit(3 * 22, "mm"),
  height = unit(10 * 6.5, "mm"),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
  border = TRUE,
  right_annotation = right_ha,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    legend_height = unit(25, "mm")
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid.text(cell_lab[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
  }
)

# Extra top margin for the header (order: bottom, left, top, right)
draw(ht_top10, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 6, 2), "mm"))

# "TF expression" header above the right-hand annotation, aligned with the
# column names (drawn on the first row slice, the top of the annotation)
decorate_annotation("tf_expr", slice = 1, {
  grid.text("TF expression",
            x = unit(0, "npc"), y = unit(1, "npc") + unit(1.5, "mm"),
            just = c("left", "bottom"),
            gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"))
})
```

# 3B. Filter to Known Transcription Factors — Sensitivity (Broad DEG Pool)

```{r combine_pools_2b}
# Sensitivity version of Section 2's combined_pool, using deg_pool_broad
# (padj<0.05 only, no |log2FC|>=1 threshold) instead of the main
# deg_pool. Compares against the main analysis to check whether TFs
# with high n_evidence_types under the strict pool retain that status
# when genes with padj<0.05 but modest fold-change are included.

combined_pool_2b <- union(deg_pool_broad, leading_edge_pool)

cat("DEG pool (broad):", length(deg_pool_broad), "\n")
cat("Leading edge pool:", length(leading_edge_pool), "\n")
cat("Combined pool (union, broad):", length(combined_pool_2b), "\n")
```

```{r filter_pool_to_tfs_2b}
candidate_tfs_2b <- intersect(combined_pool_2b, tf_catalogue)

cat("Combined pool genes that are known TFs (broad, CollecTRI):", length(candidate_tfs_2b), "\n")
```

```{r evidence_scoring_2b}
# Reuses tf_activity_sig from the main run (Section 5) — regulon
# activity does not depend on the DEG pool definition, only the DEG
# membership check (is_deg) does.

evidence_table_2b <- data.frame(TF = candidate_tfs_2b) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_deg              = TF %in% deg_pool_broad,
    is_leading_edge      = TF %in% leading_edge_pool,
    has_regulon_activity = TF %in% tf_activity_sig$source,
    n_evidence_types      = is_deg + is_leading_edge + has_regulon_activity
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tf_activity_sig, by = c("TF" = "source")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_evidence_types))

cat("=== Evidence score distribution (broad pool) ===\n")
print(table(evidence_table_2b$n_evidence_types))
```

```{r compare_main_vs_broad}
# Direct comparison: which TFs had n_evidence_types == 3 in the main
# (strict) analysis, and do they retain that status in the broad
# sensitivity pool?

main_top <- evidence_table %>% dplyr::filter(n_evidence_types == 3) %>% dplyr::pull(TF)
broad_status_of_main_top <- evidence_table_2b %>%
  dplyr::filter(TF %in% main_top) %>%
  dplyr::select(TF, n_evidence_types)

cat("Main-analysis top TFs (n_evidence_types==3):", length(main_top), "\n")
cat("Of these, how many keep n_evidence_types==3 in the broad pool:",
    sum(broad_status_of_main_top$n_evidence_types == 3), "\n\n")

print(broad_status_of_main_top)

# New TFs that reach n_evidence_types==3 only under the broad pool
# (i.e. would have been missed by the stricter main analysis)
broad_only_top <- evidence_table_2b %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_evidence_types == 3, !TF %in% main_top) %>%
  dplyr::pull(TF)

cat("\nTFs reaching n_evidence_types==3 only in the broad pool:", length(broad_only_top), "\n")
print(broad_only_top)
```

# 8. Assign Trajectory Class to Top Candidate TFs

```{r tf_trajectory_class}
# Classify trajectory shape for the main-pool top TFs AND the
# broad-pool-only TFs (Section 3B), marked separately via source_pool,
# since the latter reached n_evidence_types==3 only under the relaxed
# |log2FC| threshold and should not be silently merged with the main 45.
# Kept consistent with the gene-level trajectory_sign_class logic
# (Molecular_Signatures.Rmd) for visual consistency across the
# integrated timeline figure.

top_tfs_main  <- evidence_table %>% dplyr::filter(n_evidence_types == 3) %>% dplyr::pull(TF)
top_tfs_all   <- union(top_tfs_main, broad_only_top)

tf_activity_wide <- tf_activity %>%
  dplyr::filter(statistic == "ulm", source %in% top_tfs_all) %>%
  dplyr::select(source, condition, score) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = score)

tf_trajectory <- tf_activity_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    trajectory_class = dplyr::case_when(
      eMPC_vs_iPSC > 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 ~ "monotonic_increase",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC < 0 ~ "monotonic_decrease",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC > 0 & EC_vs_eMPC < 0 ~ "eMPC_peak",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 ~ "eMPC_trough",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    source_pool = ifelse(source %in% top_tfs_main, "main", "broad-only")
  )

cat("=== TF trajectory class distribution ===\n")
print(table(tf_trajectory$trajectory_class, tf_trajectory$source_pool))
print(as.data.frame(tf_trajectory))
```

# 10. Load DoRothEA Regulon (Cross-Check)

```{r load_dorothea_diagnostic}
dorothea_raw <- read.csv(
  "https://omnipathdb.org/interactions?datasets=dorothea&genesymbols=1&fields=dorothea_level",
  sep = "\t"
)

cat("Rows retrieved:", nrow(dorothea_raw), "\n")
print(colnames(dorothea_raw))
head(dorothea_raw)
```

```{r load_dorothea_build}
# (note: confirm against the output of the chunk above before running —
# in particular whether the confidence column is literally named
# "dorothea_level", and whether consensus_stimulation/consensus_inhibition
# are present with the same "True"/"False" string format used for
# CollecTRI in Section 3. Adjust column names below if they differ.)
dorothea_net <- dorothea_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(dorothea_level %in% c("A", "B")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(consensus_stimulation == "True" | consensus_inhibition == "True") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mor = dplyr::case_when(
      consensus_stimulation == "True" & consensus_inhibition == "False" ~ 1,
      consensus_inhibition == "True" & consensus_stimulation == "False" ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(mor)) %>%
  dplyr::select(source = source_genesymbol, target = target_genesymbol, mor) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(source, target, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("DoRothEA regulon (A+B) — TFs:", dplyr::n_distinct(dorothea_net$source), "\n")
cat("DoRothEA regulon (A+B) — TF-target edges:", nrow(dorothea_net), "\n")
```

Run the chunk above first and confirm the printed species string. Update `human_species_string` below to match exactly, then continue.

# 12. Three-Way TF Catalogue Comparison (Identity Level)

## 12.1 Catalogue Coverage per Resource
```{r catalogue_comparison_threeway}
# Answers: how many TFs each resource identifies within combined_pool,
# and how much overlap exists between the three. This level does not use
# run_ulm() — it only checks catalogue membership (candidate_tfs from
# Section 3 = CollecTRI).
catalogue_comparison <- data.frame(TF = combined_pool) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    in_collectri  = TF %in% candidate_tfs,
    in_dorothea   = TF %in% candidate_tfs_dorothea,
    in_animaltfdb = TF %in% candidate_tfs_animaltfdb
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(in_collectri | in_dorothea | in_animaltfdb) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_resources = in_collectri + in_dorothea + in_animaltfdb)

cat("=== TF catalogue coverage within combined_pool ===\n")
cat("CollecTRI:   ", sum(catalogue_comparison$in_collectri), "\n")
cat("DoRothEA:    ", sum(catalogue_comparison$in_dorothea), "\n")
cat("AnimalTFDB4: ", sum(catalogue_comparison$in_animaltfdb), "\n")
print(table(catalogue_comparison$n_resources))

# Restrict to the 45 main candidates (n_evidence_types == 3, Section 5/9)
main46_catalogue_check <- catalogue_comparison %>% dplyr::filter(TF %in% main_top)
cat("\nOf the 45 main candidates:\n")
n_main <- length(main_top)

cat(" - in CollecTRI:  ", sum(main46_catalogue_check$in_collectri), "/", n_main, "\n")
cat(" - in DoRothEA:   ", sum(main46_catalogue_check$in_dorothea), "/", n_main, "\n")
cat(" - in AnimalTFDB4:", sum(main46_catalogue_check$in_animaltfdb), "/", n_main, "\n")
# Restrict to the 10 main-figure TFs
main_figure_tfs <- c("ZEB2", "RELA", "NFKB1", "SMAD3", "LEF1",
                      "HIPK2", "NR2F2", "HEY1", "GATA2", "NOTCH1")
main_figure_catalogue_check <- catalogue_comparison %>% dplyr::filter(TF %in% main_figure_tfs)
print(main_figure_catalogue_check)
```

## 12.2 Overlap Pattern Breakdown

```{r overlap_pattern_breakdown}
# Full Venn-style breakdown of catalogue_comparison — no new
# data needed, just decomposing the three logical columns into all
# possible combinations.
catalogue_comparison <- catalogue_comparison %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    overlap_pattern = dplyr::case_when(
      in_collectri & in_dorothea & in_animaltfdb   ~ "CollecTRI + DoRothEA + AnimalTFDB4",
      in_collectri & in_dorothea & !in_animaltfdb  ~ "CollecTRI + DoRothEA only",
      in_collectri & !in_dorothea & in_animaltfdb  ~ "CollecTRI + AnimalTFDB4 only",
      !in_collectri & in_dorothea & in_animaltfdb  ~ "DoRothEA + AnimalTFDB4 only",
      in_collectri & !in_dorothea & !in_animaltfdb ~ "CollecTRI only",
      !in_collectri & in_dorothea & !in_animaltfdb ~ "DoRothEA only",
      !in_collectri & !in_dorothea & in_animaltfdb ~ "AnimalTFDB4 only",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    )
  )

cat("=== Overlap pattern across the three resources ===\n")

result_overlap <- catalogue_comparison %>%
  dplyr::count(overlap_pattern, name = "n") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

print(result_overlap)
```
## 12.3 Applicable Evidence for AnimalTFDB4-Only TFs

```{r evidence_animaltfdb_only}
# For AnimalTFDB4-only TFs, regulon activity
# cannot be computed — these genes are absent from both the CollecTRI
# and DoRothEA catalogues, so no TF-target regulon exists to test. The
# applicable evidence ceiling is therefore 2 (is_deg + is_leading_edge),
# not 3 — a resource limitation, not evidence of weaker candidacy.
animaltfdb_only_tfs <- catalogue_comparison %>%
  dplyr::filter(overlap_pattern == "AnimalTFDB4 only") %>%
  dplyr::pull(TF)

evidence_table_animaltfdb_only <- data.frame(TF = animaltfdb_only_tfs) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    is_deg = TF %in% deg_pool,
    is_leading_edge = TF %in% leading_edge_pool,
    n_applicable_evidence_types = is_deg + is_leading_edge
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_applicable_evidence_types))

cat("=== AnimalTFDB4-only TFs (n =", length(animaltfdb_only_tfs), ") — applicable evidence (max 2, regulon activity not applicable) ===\n")
evidence_summary_animaltfdb_only <- evidence_table_animaltfdb_only %>%
  dplyr::count(n_applicable_evidence_types, name = "n") %>%
  as.data.frame()
print(evidence_summary_animaltfdb_only)

strong_animaltfdb_only <- evidence_table_animaltfdb_only %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_applicable_evidence_types == 2)
cat("\nAnimalTFDB4-only TFs with BOTH is_deg and is_leading_edge (2/2):", nrow(strong_animaltfdb_only), "\n")
print(strong_animaltfdb_only)
```

# 13. DoRothEA TF Activity Scoring (decoupleR)

```{r run_ulm_dorothea}
# Mirrors Section 4's CollecTRI run: same mat_t input (t-statistics,
# backbone eBayes fit), same minsize = 5.
tf_activity_dorothea <- decoupleR::run_ulm(
  mat = mat_t,
  network = dorothea_net,
  .source = "source",
  .target = "target",
  .mor = "mor",
  minsize = 5
)

cat("DoRothEA TF activity estimates:", nrow(tf_activity_dorothea), "\n")

# TFs among the main candidates with no DoRothEA activity estimate
# (regulon below minsize = 5 in mat_t, or absent from the A+B catalogue)
missing_from_dorothea <- setdiff(main_top, unique(tf_activity_dorothea$source))
cat("Main-45 TFs without a DoRothEA activity estimate:", length(missing_from_dorothea), "\n")
print(missing_from_dorothea)
```

# 14. CollecTRI vs DoRothEA Activity Comparison

```{r compare_collectri_dorothea}
# Direction and magnitude agreement, restricted to the main candidates
# that have an estimate from both resources. Genes without a DoRothEA
# activity estimate are silently
# dropped here by the inner_join — expected, not an error.
activity_compare <- tf_activity %>%
  dplyr::filter(statistic == "ulm", source %in% main_top) %>%
  dplyr::select(source, condition, score_collectri = score) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    tf_activity_dorothea %>%
      dplyr::filter(statistic == "ulm", source %in% main_top) %>%
      dplyr::select(source, condition, score_dorothea = score),
    by = c("source", "condition")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(same_direction = sign(score_collectri) == sign(score_dorothea))

cat("=== CollecTRI vs DoRothEA activity — 45 main TFs ===\n")
cat("TFs compared:", dplyr::n_distinct(activity_compare$source), "\n")
cat("Contrast-TF pairs compared:", nrow(activity_compare), "\n")
cat("Same direction:", sum(activity_compare$same_direction), "/", nrow(activity_compare), "\n")

activity_correlation <- cor(activity_compare$score_collectri,
                             activity_compare$score_dorothea, method = "pearson")
cat("Pearson correlation (CollecTRI score vs DoRothEA score):", round(activity_correlation, 3), "\n")

# Same check restricted to the 10 main-figure TFs
main_figure_tfs <- c("ZEB2", "RELA", "NFKB1", "SMAD3", "LEF1",
                      "HIPK2", "NR2F2", "HEY1", "GATA2", "NOTCH1")
activity_compare_mainfig <- activity_compare %>% dplyr::filter(source %in% main_figure_tfs)
print(activity_compare_mainfig)
```
